_what: Opportunities Ines should personally consider applying to. Curated by the weekly board check; the daily sweep reminds her when deadlines approach. status: new | reminded | applied | skipped

Not on the board or in the newsletter: UF alumni only. ⚠ Eligibility: must be a UF alumna in good standing and 39 or under on October 5, 2026.
